summary: You choose the Italian Culture or Italian Literature subplan. The audit checks the 24 units, the subplan's two required courses (at least 8 units), and up to 12 units of second-year Italian language courses (ITALLANG 21-23, 21A, 22A), all letter graded with a C or better. The rest are electives the Director of Undergraduate Studies approves in advance, which you move in by hand: ITALIAN courses at the 100 or 200 level, courses on Italian topics in other departments, Bing Overseas Florence, ESF (up to 10 units), SLE (up to 10 units) and Digital Humanities (up to 5 units). AP credit is not accepted.

program.why: Grading: "All courses applied to the Italian Culture and Literature subplans must be taken for a letter grade and passed with at least a 'C'." These are the minor's only subplans. GPA: "A grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 or better must be achieved in each course."
